# snipeit_license (Resource)

Manages a license in Snipe-IT. Snipe-IT automatically maintains one seat per unit of `seats`; individual seats are assigned with the `snipeit_license_seat` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "snipeit_category" "software" {
  name          = "Software"
  category_type = "license"
}

resource "snipeit_license" "office" {
  name            = "Office Suite"
  seats           = 25
  category_id     = snipeit_category.software.id
  serial          = "XXXX-YYYY-ZZZZ"
  license_name    = "Example GmbH"
  license_email   = "licenses@example.com"
  purchase_date   = "2026-01-10"
  expiration_date = "2027-01-10"
  maintained      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_id` (Number) Id of the category (must be a `license` category).
- `name` (String) Name of the license.
- `seats` (Number) Number of seats. Reducing this below the number of assigned seats fails.

### Optional

- `company_id` (Number) Id of the company owning this license.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
- `license_email` (String) Email address the license is registered to.
- `license_name` (String) Name of the entity the license is registered to.
- `maintained` (Boolean) Whether the license is under maintenance.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer of this license.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `order_number` (String) Order number of the purchase.
- `purchase_cost` (String) Purchase cost as a decimal string, e.g. `1234.50`. Stored normalized; `1234.5`, `1234.50` and `1,234.50` are the same value.
- `purchase_date` (String) Purchase date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
- `purchase_order` (String) Purchase order number.
- `reassignable` (Boolean) Whether seats can be reassigned after checkin.
- `serial` (String) Product key / serial of the license.
- `supplier_id` (Number) Id of the supplier of this license.
- `termination_date` (String) Termination date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the license.
